prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web application direction mockup for a 1440px expert curation workstation
Primary request: Create a shippable-looking Chinese desktop web UI called “样片审看室”, inspired by film dailies review, a script supervisor log, and editing-bay transport controls. It is a focused per-slide curation workstation, not a marketing page and not concept art.
Scene/backdrop: The application fills the entire frame. A narrow dark utility toolbar runs across the top. The main workspace is split into a large neutral-dark monitor area on the left, approximately 62% of the width, and a bright off-white log sheet panel on the right, approximately 34%. A continuous page strip spans the full bottom like a filmstrip or dailies reel.
Subject: The left monitor must be dominated by a standard rendered presentation slide, centered large and clearly the primary evidence. The slide is sanitized Chinese business content with the title “区域经营概览”, an abstract teal bar chart, a compact table, and a simple process diagram; no real company names or sensitive data. Overlay exactly three numbered visual-object bounding boxes on the slide, labeled “01”, “02”, and “03”, using precise thin outlines and small corner tags. The right log panel has strong readable structure: header “页面总述”; sections “视觉对象 01”, “视觉对象 02”, “视觉对象 03”; visible disposition controls “纳入” and “排除”; an editable field labeled “summary 编辑”; a clearly bordered label “未确认草稿”; and an explicit review row “审核状态  pending”. Show compact notes, checkboxes or segmented controls as believable HTML/CSS controls. The bottom filmstrip clearly shows page order with thumbnails and labels “12”, “13”, “14 当前”, “15”, “16”, and a shortcut legend reading “←/→ 切换页   A 批准   X 排除   R 重新打开”. Top toolbar may include concise labels “样片审看室”, “演示文稿 07”, “第 14 / 48 页”, and a small time counter.
Style/medium: high-fidelity realistic product UI screenshot; crisp flat HTML/CSS-feasible interface; editorial control-room precision; compact expert density; no photorealistic room, no hardware frame, no people.
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2 canvas, straight-on orthographic desktop screenshot, edge-to-edge application chrome, designed for 1440px desktop. Preserve the 62/34 left-right hierarchy and full-width bottom strip. The rendered presentation slide must be the largest visual object in the composition.
Lighting/mood: neutral monitor black beside bright script-log paper; calm, rigorous, operational, trustworthy; no glow.
Color palette: exact visual direction based on #171B20 monitor black, #E8EBEC paper gray, #7CC8C5 teal selection, #F2B84B amber pencil mark, #E05D4D red exclusion. Use restrained high contrast and accessible status cues that include text, borders, or icons rather than color alone.
Materials/textures: subtle neutral monitor-black surface, lightly fibrous script-log paper, sparse grease-pencil and oil-pencil annotation marks; textures are very restrained and must not reduce UI legibility.
Text (verbatim): “样片审看室”, “演示文稿 07”, “第 14 / 48 页”, “区域经营概览”, “页面总述”, “视觉对象 01”, “视觉对象 02”, “视觉对象 03”, “纳入”, “排除”, “summary 编辑”, “未确认草稿”, “审核状态  pending”, “12”, “13”, “14 当前”, “15”, “16”, “←/→ 切换页   A 批准   X 排除   R 重新打开”
Constraints: Make the information hierarchy immediately legible at a glance. Render the quoted text faithfully where feasible, especially the panel headings, status, page order, and shortcut legend. Use square or minimally rounded controls, 1px dividers, crisp sans-serif Chinese typography, compact spacing, visible focus/selection outlines, and credible form states. The pending status and unconfirmed draft must remain understandable without relying only on color. No logos, trademarks, watermark, or sensitive content. All core controls must look implementable in ordinary HTML and CSS.
Avoid: neon, glow, gradients, glassmorphism, excessive rounded cards, floating-card stacks, marketing hero composition, oversized slogans, decorative dashboards, photos, people, cinematic room imagery, 3D hardware, skeuomorphic clutter, illegible microtext, arbitrary English lorem ipsum.
